newsitem.title: USA: LPC - Cypress taps banks for Amtrol purchase.
newsitem.headline: LPC - Cypress taps banks for Amtrol purchase.

text.p: NEW YORK, Sept 5 (LPC) - Bankers Trust New York Corp and Morgan Stanley Group Inc will lend Cypress Group $75 million to $100 million for its $218.9 million acquisition of Amtrol Inc, bankers said.
The six-year loan, which is fully underwritten, will include revolving and term portions, sources added.
Amtrol is a water flow and control company based in West Warwick, R.I. It posted 1995 sales of $172.5 million. Cypress agreed last week to pay $28.25 per share for the concern.
The loan is the first for Morgan Stanley since it set up a loan originations and syndications shop earlier this year, bankers said.
